sources.entry: Bitwarden ⚠ - Password manager with a webapp, browser extension, and mobile app. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/C#

summary.one_liner: Bitwarden Server is the C#/.NET backend (APIs, database, core infrastructure) that powers the Bitwarden password manager clients, deployable via Docker.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the backend services for Bitwarden's client applications, including APIs, the database, and other core infrastructure. It is written in C# on .NET Core with ASP.NET Core, and the database is described as T-SQL/SQL Server. The README says the codebase can be developed, built, run, and deployed on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Deployment is done with Docker containers, using provided PowerShell (Windows) and Bash (Linux/macOS) scripts to install and start the stack. The README lists production services including Admin, API, Billing, Events, EventsProcessor, Identity, Notifications, SCIM, and SSO, and says Bitwarden images are published on GitHub Container Registry. Build and contribution details are in a separate Server Setup Guide.
use_cases: develop or build Bitwarden server APIs
run Bitwarden backend on Linux, macOS, or Windows
how_to_run: Linux & macOS: curl -s -L -o bitwarden.sh <script URL> && chmod +x bitwarden.sh
notable: Backend for all official Bitwarden clients (web, browser extension, mobile)
Ships separate services for Admin, API, Billing, Identity, Events, Notifications, SCIM and SSO
Docker deployment with one-script install and start on Windows, macOS and Linux
Production images published on GitHub Container Registry
Optional git pre-commit hook for dotnet-format
caveats: This is the server backend only; clients are separate projects
Production image hash tables in the README are empty in the provided text
Build and development details are deferred to an external Server Setup Guide
Docker setup guidance is in an external help center
